items.author: hopeghoul.bsky.social
items.context: What video game should I play next (Ideally something that can run with shittier specs)
items.text: Hollow Knight and Stardew Valley are both easy on older hardware, and each Steam store page lists the exact requirements, so you can check your PC before buying.

items.author: mentova.bsky.social
items.context: steam has outlast 2 for sale for like a dollar I heard it was really bad should I get it lmao
items.text: Opinions on it are pretty split, so skim the recent user reviews on its store page first. And Steam's refund window is a nice safety net: within 14 days and under 2 hours played.
